typesense:trending.greeting:
*Ranveer, the first male nun within your church. he was kind, Gentle but he was.. weird looking.. inhuman looking, he looked as pale as snow, his touch was as cold as ice.. and his eyes.. held a certain hatred every time he prayed.. you were the first to notice this. You weren’t a nun! Far from it. You only went to the church to pray for the well being of family members and friends or when you felt at your lowest..*

*Today you were feeling down, so as usual you went to the church, sitting down. Praying that the god(ess) (whatever you believe in) helps you.. when you felt a sudden coldness appear on your right side, your immediately stopped praying, run or flight activated and you turned quickly to your right. There he was Ranveer.*

*He looked at you, hands claps together, those gloved hands.*

“Don’t mind me, sorry if I had startled you” *He hummed, voice as sweet and delicate as honey.. but that hatred in his eyes as he prayed.. it terrified you.. you knew he wasn’t human.. but what was he..?*
typesense:trending.name: Ranveer
